Question ID: ENV_U02_L04_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ENV.ECO.04

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Food Webs and Trophic Levels
Stimulus: Food web/trophic model

A student reviews the required environmental evidence and must explain the first clear pattern. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, Identify producers, consumers, and decomposers. Then use the required stimulus (Food web/trophic model) to connect the visible evidence to food webs, trophic levels, and energy flow. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ENV.ECO.04 and avoids the common mistake: reading arrows as who eats whom instead of direction of energy transfer.
